title: Unified Control policies (Release B, BAUPLAN v1.1 §7)
description: Policy documents per hierarchy level (org -> workspace -> vault -> engine), their effective merge and the signed per-engine bundle. Every member has `x-merge` (its merge rule = tightening direction: union = deny wins, intersection = allowed values every level allows, groups = every allowlist must match, min = stricter limit, true_wins/false_wins, rank = later enum value is stricter, equal = levels must agree else non_mergeable) and `x-enforcement`: `engine` = enforced by the engine's gateway policy pack field `x-engine`, `server` = enforced by Hive itself at the point `x-server` names (403 policy_denied {member, level}), whatever the engine does, `advisory` = distributed and shown, not enforced yet. Enforcement covers access through LeanCTX only.

level.description: hierarchy level, outermost first; lower levels can only tighten

excluded_paths.description: Path globs (gitignore style) whose content never enters context or shared knowledge.
excluded_paths.x-server: unsealed vaults: a push, task result, draft or code graph with a code anchor path the globs match is refused; sealed vaults stay advisory (the server cannot read their anchors)

block_secrets.description: Block agent writes and actions that carry detected secrets or PII.

pii.description: PII detector action on inbound content; redact = anonymise.

allowed_models.description: Model allowlists (glob-lite, '*' wildcard): a model is allowed when it matches a pattern of every group; an empty group allows no model.

external_model_excluded_classes.description: Data classes that are never sent to an external (remote) model.

confidential_out_of_sharing.description: Keep content classified confidential out of team sharing.

allowed_vaults.description: Vault ids an engine may use.
allowed_vaults.x-server: every engine route that names a vault (resolve, match, reads, pushes, tasks, reviews, bus v1/v2, presence, metrics): a vault outside the list is refused, a new vault too

cross_team_sharing.description: Results may be shared with other team workspaces.
cross_team_sharing.x-server: false: moving a vault to another workspace (W11) and making it public (W26) are refused

task_claim_min_role.description: Lowest member role whose agents may claim tasks.
task_claim_min_role.x-server: task claim and claim renew by an engine whose owner's role is lower are refused

auto_merge_results.description: Agent results merge into shared knowledge without a person.
auto_merge_results.x-server: false: a task result's plain ops are held as a proposal for a person instead of entering the shared log

consent_required_for.description: Actions that need a person's consent outside the agent context.
consent_required_for.x-server: trust_boundary: an engine linking a project to an existing vault is refused (a person links it); the other actions stay advisory

personal_workspace.description: Whether the team's project knowledge may go to a person's own Personal workspace.
personal_workspace.x-server: forbid: a vault of the team is never moved to a personal workspace (W11), and an engine enrolled in a team never reaches a personal vault; engines from the C line on also refuse to give a project they worked on in the team a vault in a personal workspace (older engines: advisory)

share_engine_metrics.description: Share engine metrics (hourly aggregated counters, never content) with Hive Insights; absent = the plan default.
share_engine_metrics.x-server: POST /v1/metrics/hours and POST /v1/metrics: an engine whose rule is false is refused (403 policy_denied), a vault whose rule is false has its slices and day entries refused; absent at every level = the plan default (Team, Business on; Community, Pro off until the person confirms once, 403 sharing_not_confirmed)

document.description: one level's policy document (W routes); every member optional, absent = this level adds no rule; at most 8 KiB canonical JSON

effective.description: merge of at most one document per level, in normal form: all three sections present, every set sorted ascending (bytewise), groups sorted, absent member = no level sets it

source.description: a document that went into the bundle: org/workspace scope = org_id (an organisation's org-level document: orgn_ + its id), vault = vault id, engine = instance_id

bundle.description: signed effective policy of one engine (purpose key `policy` of key set v3): Ed25519 over "leanctx.hive.effective-policy.v1\n" || canonical_json(bundle without signature), signature lowercase hex. `version` grows strictly per engine; an engine refuses a lower version or the same version with another digest (downgrade), a bundle for another org_id/instance_id, and treats it as expired after not_after (sensitive actions fail closed, the last valid rules keep restricting local work).

effective.description: org ∧ workspace ∧ engine: applies to every vault without an entry in `vaults`

vaults.description: per vault with a vault-level document: org ∧ workspace ∧ vault ∧ engine, ascending by vault_id

digest.description: digest of `policy`; the engine acks it

bundle_response.description: GET /v1/policy/bundle for Hive-Protocol 2.x: the C0 1.x members unchanged plus `effective_policy` (null only when this server has no lease signing key)

ack_request.description: POST /v1/policy/ack: the engine applied this bundle; `unenforced` lists the members this engine cannot enforce (`x-enforcement: engine`); server-enforced members are never listed. With `refused`: the engine received this bundle (`version`, `digest` as received) but refused it and keeps applying the bundle `refused.applied_version` (null: it holds no valid bundle); `unenforced` is then absent

detail.description: the engine's diagnostic line, no content

refusal_reason.description: why an engine refused a received bundle: invalid_bundle (does not parse or validate), wrong_target (issued for another org or engine), key_unavailable (no verified key set v3 or no valid policy key for key_id), signature_invalid, digest_mismatch (digest is not the policy's), downgrade (older version, or the same version with another digest), expired (not_after already passed), install_failed (verified but could not be stored)

state.description: outdated: a newer bundle was issued to this engine since

ack_refused_response.description: POST /v1/policy/ack answer to a refusal (`refused` in the request): recorded; the normal ack answer is ack_response
